parent_objective: design recurrent-dependence ablation diagnostics after BC family route/OOD pass

public_gates: design BC5660 normal vs reset/zero-current/zero-action ablation benchmarks
define same-distribution and moderate-OOD fresh seed blocks
do not train evaluate or promote in design milestone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from route/OOD metrics alone
do not run PPO or behavior cloning
do not promote before recurrent-dependence diagnostics
hypothesis: Because the scaled BC family transfers L2 behavior reliably, the next diagnostic should test whether the deployed L3 actor depends on recurrent command-response history.
success_criteria: design specifies ablation policies and seed blocks
design specifies benchmark commands using existing checkpoint ablation support
design specifies diagnostic degradation thresholds and interpretation rules
failure_criteria: design treats ablations as promotion by themselves
design changes checkpoint weights or actor inputs

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write recurrent-dependence ablation benchmark design; no evaluation.

decision_rule: M581 passes because it pre-registers recurrent-dependence ablation diagnostics without evaluation, training, promotion, or actor-contract changes.
